title: 🤖 TileMapLayer cursor preview ignores project default Nearest filtering when the layer uses Inherit
body: AI disclosure and correction: The initial report was drafted and submitted by an AI agent. The issue description below now contains the reporter's original Chinese text and its English translation. The attached MRP, screenshots, and supplemental test steps were prepared by the agent. The earlier source-code analysis has been removed. ### Tested versions Reported by the user: 4.7.2.stable and 4.8.dev6. Attached MRP tested by the agent: 4.8.dev6.official.8898c2b3d (Compatibility). ### System information Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - AMD Ryzen 9 7940HX with Radeon Graphics - 31.21 GiB memory ### Issue description English translation of the reporter's original description: > I noticed a problem while using Godot 4.7.2 stable. I have set Project Settings > Rendering > Textures > Canvas Textures > Default Texture Filter to Nearest. There is a TileMapLayer node in the scene with its texture filter set to Inherit. The placed pixel-art tiles do use nearest-neighbor filtering correctly, but the tile preview when hovering the mouse over a grid cell still uses linear filtering and looks very blurry. I also tested 4.8 dev6, and the problem is still there. Original Chinese: > 我在使用godot4.7.2stable时发现了一个问题： > 我已经设置了：项目设置->渲染->纹理->画布纹理->默认纹理过滤：Nearest，场景中有一个tilemaplayer节点，其纹理过滤为继承。放置的像素瓦片贴图确实正常使用了最近邻过滤，但是鼠标悬停在一个网格上的瓦片预览仍然是线性过滤，会非常模糊。我测试过4.8 dev6仍然有这个问题。 ### Steps to reproduce Supplemental steps for the agent-prepared MRP: 1. Import the attached project and open `main.tscn` in 4.8.dev6. 2. Select TileMapLayer and select the checkerboard tile in the TileMap panel. The project default filter is Nearest; the layer and its parent use Inherit. 3. Zoom in and hover beside the three placed tiles. The cursor preview is blurry while the placed tiles are sharp. 4. Set the layer's Texture > Filter to Nearest. The preview becomes sharp. Undoing this change makes it blurry again. Screenshots from the agent's local test: Inherit first, explicit Nearest second. The cursor preview is to the right of the three placed tiles. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Agent-prepared project containing `project.godot` and `main.tscn`, with an embedded checker texture and TileSet. [tile-preview-filter-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32454778/tile-preview-filter-mrp.zip)
